name: Airlite Plastics Co.
old_description: We’re proud of our storied past, but our sights are set on the future. Every day, our goal is to better our process, planet, and customers’ business.
about:
Airlite Plastics Co. operates from Omaha, Nebraska, as a family-owned packaging manufacturer. The company emphasizes its long history while focusing on future-oriented innovation, though a specific founding year is not disclosed.

The company produces in-mold labeled (IML) and round containers, lids, and drink cups, including oxygen-barrier versions that incorporate an EVOH layer to extend shelf life. Its proprietary FDA-approved resin blends are used across product lines such as cultured foods, household items, horticulture containers, and high-pressure processing (HPP) applications. Decoration capabilities encompass in-mold labeling, flexographic printing with up to eight colors, and dry offset printing with in-house plate production. Engineering services, custom graphics, package design, and marketing support round out the offering.

Airlite serves brands in cultured dairy, household products, horticulture, and temperature-controlled shipping, providing packaging that withstands HPP and cold-chain requirements. Customers range from food processors needing oxygen-barrier containers to horticultural suppliers and consumer-goods companies seeking custom-decorated cups and lids.

The company cites its family-owned structure as a source of responsiveness, avoiding bureaucratic layers to maintain decades-long partnerships. It highlights a track record of pioneering IML packaging, oxygen-barrier technology, and HPP-compatible containers, alongside a sustainability ethos that aims to benefit both the planet and the customer's bottom line.
